notes: Tailwind v4 / Tailwind UI 'Catalyst' template on Next.js; Inter from rsms.me. Colors converted from the profile's lab()/oklab() samples to hex/rgba: zinc-100 canvas, zinc-950 ink, zinc-500 muted, zinc-950/5 hairlines. Accent is semantic-only (lime-400 wash + lime-700 text for positive deltas; pink for negative) — the rest of Tailwind's rainbow ships in tokens but is unused on this screen. The full Tailwind color/spacing variable set (174 custom props) was collapsed to the roles actually in play. Dark axis filled from craft.theme.dark (supportsDark=true). reduced_motion flagged not-respected (no PRM rule) but the screen is effectively static, so real risk is nil. The single scroll 'pin' is the fixed sidebar; the 60-target IntersectionObserver is route prefetch, not reveal animation.
